title: Paginated feed reducer
summary: Cursor pagination with refresh, guarded load-more and stale response handling.
prompt:
Write `feedReducer(state, action)` for an infinite list. State: `{ items, cursor, status, generation, hasMore }` where `status` is `'idle' | 'loading' | 'loadingMore' | 'refreshing' | 'error'`.

- `refresh`: status `refreshing`, increment `generation`.
- `loadMore`: only when status is `idle`, `hasMore` is true and `cursor` is not null; set `loadingMore`. Otherwise return the same state object.
- `loaded { generation, items, nextCursor, replace }`: ignore it (same state) if `generation` differs from state's. Otherwise replace or append items (dropping items whose `id` is already present), set `cursor` to `nextCursor`, `hasMore` to `nextCursor !== null` and status `idle`.
- `failed { generation }`: if current, set status `error`.

`initialFeed` has `cursor: null` and `hasMore: true`; the first page is loaded with `refresh`. There is no React Native runtime here, so this is modelled as plain TypeScript.
hints: Keep `generation` in the action so a slow page cannot overwrite a newer refresh.
Dedupe with a `Set` of existing ids.
